title: Judge Pained as He Grants Dismissal of Jan. 6 Charges Against Oath Keepers
summary: The judge, Amit P. Mehta, blasted the administration’s request for a dismissal in the case, saying it bestowed “unearned grace” on the Oath Keepers defendants “by wiping their records clean.”
